levels.surface: أبي محمد هارون بن موسى التلعكبري

notes: «على أبي الحسين محمد بن جعفر الاسدي» is where the sheikh met people, not a transmitter of this report; left out.
The Mahdi speaks and acts inside the account of al-Awdi (rule 11: a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks), so whether the Imam is a link is for a ruling.
«أظن ذلك قبل سنة ثلاثمائة» is Ahmad's guess about a date, not a name.
